profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Bloomberg
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Hello! I graduated from the University of Maryland in Spring 2023, with a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science. I joined Bloomberg as a Software Engineer in Fall 2023, and there I have remained, diligently developing my abilities since.

At Bloomberg, I started out working on a back-end distributed systems project, but now spend most of my time developing a full stack video conferencing web app. Prior to Bloomberg, I also gained extensive front-end development experience as an intern at Meta.

As of right now, I am not tied to any specific tech stack, I just want to learn and grow as much as possible.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
▪	ROOM - Full stack web based video conferencing React app. Proactively engineered and took ownership of end to end core conferencing features. Interfaced with open-source technologies WebRTC and Jitsi-Meet.
▪	VCFG - Internal tool used for managing RabbitMQ message queues, built independently by me to help my team adaptively handle large load to our distributed system in real time.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
‣ Rapidly self-taught Hack and new development tools to engineer front-end design modifications to FBLite Watch tab search, lessening the discrepancy between FBLite and FB to give users a consistent Watch experience 
‣ Proactively ramped up on back-end development to render Reels in addition to Videos in Watch search results 
‣ Designed, monitored, and analyzed 6 experiments based on A/B testing and discovered increases in video engagement and watch time
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · A/B Testing · Unity · Hack · Mercurial

positions.title: Systems Integration Intern
positions.description:
‣ Proactively and independently learned Python and Bash scripting to automate over 100 testing procedures including data input, server pings, system installation, scenario kicks, and more, reducing hours of human testing and limiting human error
‣ Debugged and addressed 9 crucial errors in a long Sikuli tool by parsing through 500+ lines of code in a new language
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) · Sikuli · Automation · Bash Scripting
